test.query: SELECT w, ip, count(), sum(r), avg(rw) FROM (SELECT intHash64(number) AS w, toUInt32(number) AS ip, toInt16(number % 2) AS r, toInt16(number % 1920) AS rw FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) GROUP BY w, ip FORMAT Null

SELECT w, ip, count() AS c, sum(r), avg(rw) FROM (SELECT intHash64(number) AS w, toUInt32(number) AS ip, toInt16(number % 2) AS r, toInt16(number % 1920) AS rw FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) GROUP BY w, ip ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10 FORMAT Null
SELECT w, ip, count(), sum(a), avg(b) FROM (SELECT intHash64(number) AS w, toUInt32(number) AS ip, number AS a, toUInt64(number % 1920) AS b FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) GROUP BY w, ip FORMAT Null

SELECT w, ip, count(), sum(a), avg(b), min(c), max(d) FROM (SELECT intHash64(number) AS w, toUInt32(number) AS ip, number AS a, toUInt64(number % 1920) AS b, toUInt64(number % 7) AS c, toUInt64(number % 11) AS d FROM numbers_mt(10000000)) GROUP BY w, ip FORMAT Null
